title: Desert Oracle Shrine
one_sentence: A small sunlit shrine courtyard where sand channels, carved stone, and an oracle mirror create a Wonder expansion seed.
source_prompt: A desert oracle shrine at sunset, with wind-carved arches, a central mirror altar, sand channels, incense braziers, cloth shade, and a sealed sun door.

intent.setting: A compact shrine courtyard surrounded by low walls and wind-shaped arches.
intent.emotional_goal: The first view should feel peaceful, deliberate, and full of old ritual logic.
intent.primary_interaction: Inspect the oracle mirror and decide whether to unlock the sealed sun door.
intent.spatial_logic: Sand channels lead from the entry path to the central mirror and onward to the sealed door.

style.lighting: Low sunset light grazes carved stone while braziers add warm points near the mirror.

required_elements.description: A low stone wall and arch shell defining the shrine boundary.
A polished mirror disc mounted on the central altar.
A readable sand channel path that connects entry, mirror, and door.
Small braziers that mark the ritual circle around the mirror.
A locked door with a sun mark beyond the central mirror.
Background shade shapes that frame the courtyard edge.

camera_intents.purpose: Show the courtyard shell, mirror altar, and sealed sun door.
Inspect the oracle mirror and sand channels.

curiosity_goals: What does the oracle mirror reflect at sunset?
Why do the sand channels point at the sealed sun door?
authoring_notes: Phase 32 JSON-only Wonder example focused on courtyard modules, ritual navigation, and compact preview budgets.
